mission.finding: The packet advances the data-to-evidence route by making a future stream probe falsifiable before any quota, provider or raw-retention action is used.

flexibility.finding: The reusable unit is a proposal/evaluator pattern. It preserves target and terminal semantics, while provider selection, transport implementation, decoder and reconciliation remain replaceable future gates.

research_truth.finding: The contract preserves the distinction between no observed notification and no transaction. UNKNOWN cannot be projected, flattened, retried or promoted.

owner_operability.finding: The Russian readout exposes target, caps, retention class, stop rule and exact future phrase without requiring the owner to inspect code or disclose a credential.

execution_to_cashflow.finding: This is a read-only technical proposal. It makes no trade, execution, inventory, settlement, PnL or NetReturn assertion.

monitoring_recovery.finding: A future foreground pilot stops on transport loss and retains only a safe receipt. Reconciliation is deliberately a separate owner-authorised action.

reuse_first.fit: The existing bounded WSS capture, redaction and receipt pattern is relevant, but its Pump logsSubscribe binding/parser is explicitly unfit for direct reuse.

now.value: A future one-shot technical probe can be approved or declined with all material limits visible before a connection is opened.
now.activation_trigger: The owner chooses to spend a measured provider quota on this named pool.

watch.value: Replay-capable streaming can reduce recovery uncertainty only if a valid first pilot reveals a material coverage gap.
watch.activation_trigger: A future retained technical observation still leaves the named consumer blocked on coverage or recovery truth.
